entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Masjid Abdul Gaffoor and occasionally known as the Dunlop Street Mosque, is a historic mosque located in Little India, Singapore. Named after its founder Shaik Abdul Gaffoor, it was originally built in 1910 as a replacement of an older mosque located along Dunlop Street. It was gazetted as a national monument of Singapore in 1979.
